title: Carry-forward (r3 W2): the pullback-yields app7 leg still persists to the developer's real $HOME/.pp-settings.bin on every native test run
detail: effect_settings_adjust always calls settings_save_app; the zeroed fixture's empty override falls back to the real HOME dotfile, clobbering the dev's settings with auto_pullback OFF every run.
recommended_fix: Set app7.settings_path_override to a temp path (the settings_test pattern) before the toggle leg, or have the fixture default the override to a temp file.

title: Carry-forward (r3 N12): the PR-body claim 'a second SEED mid-ease retargets it' still has no test — an early-out-when-armed regression passes all gates
evidence:
_pr_body_camera_zoom.md: "Any user camera input (wheel, pan, selection, ESC)
  yields the pullback instantly; a second SEED mid-ease
  retargets it." app/main.odin pullback_feed: `		app.cam_zoom_to = z_to
		app.cam_wx_to = cx_to
		app.cam_wy_to = cy_to
		app.pullback = true` (unconditional, no armed-early-out — but unpinned). grep for a retarget/mid-ease second-seed test finds none in app/pullback_test.odin.
detail: A claimed behavior of the ruling's implementation is unpinned: a regression that skips feed work while pullback is armed would keep every existing test green.
recommended_fix: Add a pin: arm the pullback, advance camera_update a few frames, spawn a second seed in a new direction, feed, assert cam_wx_to/cam_zoom_to re-assigned toward the new district.

title: Carry-forward (r3 N4): start_run's pan-latch reset remains untested — deleting the reset keeps every gate green
evidence: app/main.odin:746: `	app.input.panning = false // v2-camera-zoom: a fresh run closes any stray pan latch` — grep for start_run across app/*_test.odin, app/input/*_test.odin, app/render/*_test.odin returns nothing; pan_latch_lifecycle_pins_stale_guard_and_modal_clear pins release/begin_draw/modal/suppress only.
detail: The lifecycle pin covers four of five documented transitions; the start_run reset (r2 W10's ask) is the unpinned fifth — a restart mid-pan regression ships silently.
recommended_fix: Arm the latch via an empty-ground press, call start_run, assert input.panning == false (the app-level fixture pattern already exists).

title: Carry-forward (r3 N11): camera_newest_terminals still has no direct unit pins — the 0-found bail, the 8-id truncation, dead-id skip, and event<->id ordering are unpinned
evidence: app/render/camera.odin:108: `camera_newest_terminals :: proc(topo: ^pp.Topology, n: u32, ids: []u32) -> u32 {` — grep for camera_newest_terminals in app/render/camera_test.odin and app/pullback_test.odin returns nothing (only the indirect pullback_walk test). app/main.odin:1646: `	ids: [8]u32` (the found != n_spawns bail on a 9+ spawn frame is never exercised).
detail: The W4 fix's core proc is covered only indirectly; its degenerate edges (found<n return, >8-spawn silent skip, dead-id continue, newest-first order) have no direct pins.
recommended_fix: Add unit pins in camera_test.odin: n=0, n beyond live terminals, 9 spawns vs the 8-slot buffer, a dead id mid-walk, and the newest-first ordering assertion.

title: B2's root-cause gate is itself unpinned: no test asserts effect_overlay leaves overlay_on untouched in a release build
detail: Deleting the PP_DEBUG gate from effect_overlay (the exact r3 B2 root cause) passes both CI test legs — only the fall-through symptom is pinned, not the gate.
recommended_fix: Add a when-branched leg: in the else branch call effect_overlay on overlay_on=false and assert it stays false (the release no-op).

title: Carry-forward (r3 N14): the W4 pin's fixture-id comments are still wrong — 'id 6'/'id 7' vs actual ids 3 and 4
evidence:
app/pullback_test.odin:106-107: `	spawn_with_event(&app, {23, 10}) // id 6: the seed, >= 10 tiles from every terminal
	place_router(&app, {30, 10}) // id 7: a junction, NO event — NEWER than the seed` — core/types.odin run_init: `state^ = {} ... topology_make(&state.topology, allocator)` (spawns nothing); topology_spawn_node allocates `id := t.next_node_id` from 0; the fixture spawns ids 0,1,2, so the seed is id 3 and the router id 4.
detail: The pin itself is substantive (verified: the walk probes router id 4, skips it, finds seed id 3), but the id comments mislead future maintenance — second round unfixed.
recommended_fix: Correct the comments to id 3 / id 4 (run_init spawns no nodes; ids are 0-based).

title: Wrong band/target math in the new r4 pin comments: live-2.0 y-band is [234,702] not [195,585]; 2.0 x-band is [416,1248] not [278,762]; ease target is ~2.13 not ~1.78
evidence: Line 120: `// [195, 585]) but MUST clamp to the world center at the 1.0 target — the`; line 147: `	app2.cam_wx_to = 700 // the wheel's off-center anchor (valid at 2.0: [278, 762])`; line 186: `// the 4.0 -> ~1.78 fixture delta converges at ~119 frames).` Fixture math: fit=10/13; y-band at 2.0 = 468±360/(fit·2) = [234,702]; x-band = 832±640/(fit·2) = [416,1248] (the line-150 assertion itself uses the correct [416,1248]); pullback target z_x = 640/((10/13)·390) = 2.13, converging ~frame 116 (both inside the asserted bounds, so the pins hold).
detail: Three comment numbers are computed against the wrong fixture (1.78/119 are FIT42 40×30-world values); assertions are correct, but the comments mislead audits.
recommended_fix: Fix the three comments to [234,702], [416,1248], and target ~2.13 / ~116 frames for the 64×36 fixture.
